translations.web: He said, “Your brother came with deceit, and has taken away your blessing.”
translations.bsb: But Isaac replied, “Your brother came deceitfully and took your blessing.”
translations.kjv: And he said, Thy brother came with subtilty, and hath taken away thy blessing.
translations.asv: And he said, Thy brother came with guile, and hath taken away thy blessing.
